purpose: Solve absolute scalar and P0669 tensor AQUAL on the identical spent RX J2129 physical source and integrate both zero-slip photon-deflection fields before any raw lens outcome is scored.

field_equations.scalar: div[mu(|grad Phi_s|/a0) grad Phi_s] = 4 pi G rho_bar
field_equations.tensor: div[mu(|grad Phi_t|/a0) (I-sigma h h) grad Phi_t] = 4 pi G rho_bar
field_equations.photon: alpha_perp=-(2/c^2) integral a_perp dz before multiplication by Dds/Ds

audit_region.deflections: physical angular deflection before Dds/Ds, sampled on the P0670 x-y grid

selection_rule: Advance the one absolute tensor field to a separately frozen spent raw-lens topology audit only if both nonlinear solves, shared boundary, zero-slip fields, non-null but stable tensor response, parameter count, and no-score gates pass.
claim_boundary: A numerical field solve is not a derivation of the weak-field metric from a covariant action.
The simple-MOND scalar sector is a comparator and boundary closure; P0671 tests whether the P0669 tensor term makes a measurable absolute change on the same source.
A nonzero tensor change is not necessarily large enough or correctly shaped to reproduce multiple-image topology.
No raw image root, residual, parity, multiplicity, critical curve, or sealed target is evaluated in P0671.
